section.title: Cloud accounts
section.empty: No cloud accounts yet. Link an AWS account with a scoped role or add an Oracle API key.

destructive.name: Destructive
destructive.hint: Terminate and delete. Off unless you need it.

wizard.title: Link an AWS account
wizard.description: Create a least privilege role in your account, then hand Levelrail its ARN. No access keys are stored.
wizard.needsAdmin: Only an administrator can link a cloud account.

scope.regionsHint: Comma separated. Leave empty for every region.
scope.zonesHint: Route 53 zone ids, comma separated. Required for the dns and destructive tiers.
scope.principalHint: The AWS identity Levelrail runs as. It is the only one allowed to assume the role.
scope.principalPrefilled: Prefilled from the identity Levelrail runs as (account {{account}}). You can edit it.
scope.principalNotConfigured: No AWS identity found. Run aws login or set AWS credentials for the Levelrail process, or paste the ARN.

issues.badRegions: Use region ids such as eu-west-1.
issues.needsZones: Add the hosted zone ids the dns and destructive tiers may touch.
issues.badZones: Use zone ids such as Z0123ABCD.
issues.badPrincipal: Enter an IAM root, role or user ARN.
issues.badRegion: Use a region id such as us-east-1.
issues.badAccountId: Enter a 12 digit AWS account id.
issues.badVaultAddress: Enter an http or https Vault address.
issues.badVaultRole: Use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
issues.badVaultToken: Enter a secret:// reference such as secret://vault/levelrail#token.

kit.readFirst: Review the policy JSON before you create anything. The role can only do what it allows, and the external id guards against a confused deputy.
kit.noQuickCreate: No quick create link without a template URL. Use the template or Terraform below.

vault.use: Use Vault for short lived credentials
vault.hint: Levelrail reads temporary keys from your Vault aws secrets engine. No access keys are stored.
vault.kitHint: Run the Vault commands, create the IAM role {{arn}} with the policy and trust policy, then connect.

detail.deleteBody: The stored credential is removed and grants stop working. Resources in the cloud account are not touched. Type the name to confirm.

access.needsShare: You need the share permission on this account to see who has access.
access.empty: No grants yet. Only administrators can use this account.

spend.title: Spend this month
spend.limitedIn: Refreshed recently. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

state.tag_not_active: Cost allocation tag is not active

hint.disabled: Turn on cloud spend in the runtime settings.
hint.tag_not_active: Activate the levelrail:project cost allocation tag in the billing console, then refresh.
hint.data_unavailable: Grant the account cost read access and refresh.

instances.noAccess: You do not have access to list instances on this account.

stop.title: Stop {{name}}?
stop.body: The instance goes offline until it is started again.

resize.title: Resize {{name}}
resize.oracleReboot: Resizing an Oracle instance reboots it.

terminate.title: Terminate {{name}}?
terminate.body: The instance is deleted at the provider and cannot be recovered. Type the name to confirm.

detail.readOnly: Tags are read only for this instance.

services.disabled: This service is off. A root user can enable it here or in runtime settings.
services.disabledRoot: This service is off. Use the switch to enable it.

audit.hint: Enter a resource name to see its recent events.

rds.title: Databases (RDS and Aurora)
rds.name: Name
rds.createBody: Created with encryption on, private access, a stop or teardown timer and tags. Needs the guard to allow the class and cost.
rds.classBlocked: This class is not on the allowlist.
rds.passwordNote: The master password is generated by AWS and kept in Secrets Manager. Levelrail never stores it.
